title: Regenerate Genz App logo asset for crisp header rendering

requirements.text: Regenerate the existing Genz App logo image at `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` so it is a crisp, sharp 512×512 PNG that still looks clear when rendered as a small rounded app icon in the header (e.g., ~40×40 to ~80×80 CSS pixels).
acceptanceCriteria: The file `frontend/public/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` exists and is a valid 512×512 PNG.
The logo appears sharp (not blurry/pixelated) when displayed in the header at the current responsive sizes (see `frontend/src/components/Header.tsx` where it is shown with rounded corners).
The public asset path remains exactly `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` (no filename/path changes required elsewhere).

constraints: Do not change the logo public asset path `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`.
Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not redesign the header layout, navigation, or typography.
Do not change the app name or any user-facing copy.

edits: Increase sharpness and edge definition; ensure clean transparency and crisp shapes at small sizes (genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png > genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png)
